item.title: Alice In Chains to release 30th anniversary deluxe box set for self-titled album
item.description: Alice in Chains have announced a deluxe reissue of their 1995 self-titled album in honor of its 30th anniversary. The deluxe 30th anniversary box set features pop-up gatefold packaging, three 7″ singles for the album’s original run

item.title: Red Hot Chili Peppers bassist Flea shares video for ‘A Plea’ from debut solo album
item.description: Red Hot Chili Peppers bassist Flea teased the release of his debut solo album with his first-ever solo single, “A Plea.” The tracklist, guest appearances, and additional details for the as-yet-untitled solo project will be revealed sometime

item.title: Neve Campbell returns to the ‘Scream’ franchise in trailer for ‘Scream 7’
item.description: Paramount Pictures has released a poster and trailer for its upcoming ‘Scream 7’, featuring the return of Neve Campbell’s heroine, Sidney, who joins reporter Gale (Courteney Cox), to figure out the identity of the new copycat Ghostface
